recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future desire to clarify the transaction narrative should be handled as a separate editorial tracker coordinated with the Extension Pack, not as a missing application of FHIR-38649.
issue_request: FHIR-38649 was a Published FHIR-core change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking that resolve-as-version-specific be usable on uri and url in addition to Reference while not attempting to solve embedded narrative, markdown, href, or img URL cases without a practical use case.
initial_application: The current FHIR core checkout no longer owns the extension StructureDefinition source; core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed extension definitions from R5 source. The applied FHIR-38649 source change is in HL7/fhir-extensions commit 6c6f51f32afbe1a4f1071d615c89f88b6620b3da, which added uri and url contexts to StructureDefinition-resolve-as-version-specific.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes first questioned whether this was a real use case and then recorded the Persuasive with Modification 8-0-1 disposition. The originating Zulip discussion identified url/uri as the bounded extension-context fix and narrative/markdown/href/img as harder cases. FHIR-34343 created the original Reference extension mechanism; FHIR-43600 later added an example using the same extension but did not alter the uri/url scope.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The Extension Pack source and current rendered Extension Pack page both list Reference, uri, and url as contexts for resolve-as-version-specific, while core http.html links to that external extension definition rather than carrying an active core StructureDefinition to edit.

related_jiras.note: Created the original resolve-as-version-specific mechanism that FHIR-38649 later broadened to uri and url contexts.
Added a Provenance transaction example using the same extension, confirming the extension remains active but not changing the uri/url scope decision.
